newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria Nestle loses shine on poor result.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria Nestle loses shine on poor result.

text.p: Shares of Nestle Nigeria, which became the toast of the Nigerian stock market in May this year, are now losing itheir appeal after the company posted a poor first quarter result on Monday, dealers said on Wednesday.

Nestle became the hottest stock on the market when it declared full year 1996 profits of 1.2 billion naira, double those of the previous year, and rewarded investors generously with a one-for-one scrip issue and six naira per share dividend.
But on Monday it announced first quarter profit to end-March 1997 of 101.2 million naira from 112.1 million for the same year ago period, blaming it on Nigeria's economic recession.
The shares, which displaced quoted oil marketers as the hottest share on the market, experienced an unprecedented price appreciation until Monday's announcement.
It closed steady on Wednesday at 52.30 naira but some Nestle shares went on offer with no takers, traders said.
"Nestle's 1996 results have proved a hard act to follow, " said one dealer, adding that some investors were becoming nervous and would rather run with handsome gains made so far.
"They fear what befell other blue chips could be knocking on Nestle's doors," he said.
